Mctt.Core.Syntactic.System.Structural

Properties of the Judgments

Substitution is a meta-level operation, so its closure properties are lemmas rather than rules. There are two groups:
  • the algebraic ones: wk_id, ↑, wk_q, _⊙_ and their substitution counterparts are well-typed;
  • the transport ones: weakening and substitution preserve typing, term equality and subtyping (wk_preserves_wf, sub_preserves_wf, sub_eq_preserves_exp).
The two groups are interleaved, because wf_sub_q needs wk_preserves_wf: it has to weaken the image of a substitution by one. The order below is therefore weakening typing, wk_preserves_wf, substitution typing, sub_preserves_wf.

From Stdlib Require Import Lia Classes.RelationClasses Setoid Morphisms.

From Mctt Require Import LibTactics.
From Mctt.Core Require Import Base.
From Mctt.Core.Syntactic.System Require Export Scoping MemberLemmas IndSyntax.
Import Syntax_Notations Wk_Notations.
#[local] Open Scope list_scope.

Basic Inversions and Presuppositions


Lemma ctx_lookup_lt : forall {Γ A x},
    Γ ∋ #x : A ->
    x < length Γ.
Proof.
  induction 1; simpl; lia.
Qed.

#[export]
Hint Resolve ctx_lookup_lt : mctt.

The variable rules look up in the local context extended by the parameters in scope; a lookup in the local context is one of those.
Lemma ctx_lookup_app_l : forall {Γ Δ A x},
    Γ ∋ #x : A ->
    Γ ++ Δ ∋ #x : A.
Proof.
  induction 1; cbn; constructor; assumption.
Qed.

#[export]
Hint Resolve ctx_lookup_app_l : mctt.

wf_ctx_extend carries no context premise, so ⊢ Γ is not an inversion of the context judgment but a presupposition of typing. These come first, each by an induction that reads it off whichever premise is stated at Γ; ctx_decomp is a consequence.

Lemma presup_ext_eq_ctx : forall {Θ Ξ Γ Ψ Ψ'}, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ Ψ ≈ Ψ' -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ.
Proof.
  induction 1; auto.
Qed.

#[export]
Hint Resolve presup_ext_eq_ctx : mctt.

Lemma presup_unit_eq_ctx : forall {Θ Ξ Γ U U'}, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ U ≈ U' -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ.
Proof.
  induction 1; mautosolve 2.
Qed.

#[export]
Hint Resolve presup_unit_eq_ctx : mctt.

Lemma presup_modexp_eq_ctx : forall {Θ Ξ Γ H H'}, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H' -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ.
Proof.
  induction 1; mautosolve 2.
Qed.

#[export]
Hint Resolve presup_modexp_eq_ctx : mctt.

A unit equivalence presupposes the reflexive instances of both sides.
Lemma wf_unit_eq_refl_left : forall {Θ Ξ Γ U U'}, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ U ≈ U' -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ U ≈ U.
Proof. intros; eapply wf_unit_eq_trans; [ eassumption | apply wf_unit_eq_sym; eassumption ]. Qed.

Lemma wf_unit_eq_refl_right : forall {Θ Ξ Γ U U'}, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ U ≈ U' -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ U' ≈ U'.
Proof. intros; eapply wf_unit_eq_trans; [ apply wf_unit_eq_sym; eassumption | eassumption ]. Qed.

Lemma wf_modexp_eq_refl_left : forall {Θ Ξ Γ H H'}, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H' -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H.
Proof. intros; eapply wf_me_trans; [ eassumption | apply wf_me_sym; eassumption ]. Qed.

Lemma wf_modexp_eq_refl_right : forall {Θ Ξ Γ H H'}, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H' -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H' ≈ H'.
Proof. intros; eapply wf_me_trans; [ apply wf_me_sym; eassumption | eassumption ]. Qed.

Lemma ctx_decomp_mod : forall {Θ Ξ Γ U},
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹ₘ U ->
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ /\ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ U ≈ U.
Proof.
  inversion 1; eauto using presup_unit_eq_ctx.
Qed.

Corollary ctx_decomp_mod_left : forall {Θ Ξ Γ U}, ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹ₘ U -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ.
Proof. intros * ?%ctx_decomp_mod; easy. Qed.

Corollary ctx_decomp_mod_unit : forall {Θ Ξ Γ U}, ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹ₘ U -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ U ≈ U.
Proof. intros * ?%ctx_decomp_mod; easy. Qed.

#[export]
Hint Resolve ctx_decomp_mod_left ctx_decomp_mod_unit : mctt.

Lemma presup_exp_ctx : forall {Θ Ξ Γ M A}, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : A -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ.
Proof.
  induction 1; mautosolve 2.
Qed.

#[export]
Hint Resolve presup_exp_ctx : mctt.

Lemma presup_exp_eq_ctx : forall {Θ Ξ Γ M M' A}, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : A -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ.
Proof.
  induction 1; mautosolve 2.
Qed.

#[export]
Hint Resolve presup_exp_eq_ctx : mctt.

Lemma presup_subtyp_ctx : forall {Θ Ξ Γ A B}, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A ⊆ B -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ.
Proof.
  induction 1; mautosolve 2.
Qed.

#[export]
Hint Resolve presup_subtyp_ctx : mctt.

A small type is a type of every large universe.
Lemma wf_exp_small_large : forall {Θ Ξ Γ A o i},
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A : Type⟨𝕃ᵒ o⟩ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A : Typeω@i.
Proof. intros; eapply wf_exp_subtyp'; [ eassumption | eapply wf_subtyp_small_large; mauto 3 ]. Qed.

The same at a level term, given that it is a level.
Lemma wf_exp_suniv_large : forall {Θ Ξ Γ A L i n},
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ L : Level@n -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A : Type⟨L⟩ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A : Typeω@i.
Proof. intros; eapply wf_exp_subtyp'; [ eassumption | eapply wf_subtyp_small_large; mauto 3 ]. Qed.

Lemma wf_exp_eq_suniv_large : forall {Θ Ξ Γ A A' L i n},
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ L : Level@n -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A ≈ A' : Type⟨L⟩ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A ≈ A' : Typeω@i.
Proof. intros; eapply wf_exp_eq_subtyp'; [ eassumption | eapply wf_subtyp_small_large; mauto 3 ]. Qed.

The small Π and its congruence at a literal level, whose weakening is itself.
Lemma wf_pi_small_lit : forall {Θ Ξ Γ A B n},
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A : Type⟨𝕃ᵒ n⟩ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹ A ⊢ B : Type⟨𝕃ᵒ n⟩ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ Π A B : Type⟨𝕃ᵒ n⟩.
Proof. intros * HA HB; eapply wf_pi_small; [ apply wf_llit_ord; mauto 2 | exact HA | exact HB ]. Qed.

Lemma wf_exp_eq_pi_cong_small_lit : forall {Θ Ξ Γ A A' B B' n},
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A : Type⟨𝕃ᵒ n⟩ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A ≈ A' : Type⟨𝕃ᵒ n⟩ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹ A ⊢ B ≈ B' : Type⟨𝕃ᵒ n⟩ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ Π A B ≈ Π A' B' : Type⟨𝕃ᵒ n⟩.
Proof. intros * HA HAA HB; eapply wf_exp_eq_pi_cong_small; [ apply wf_llit_ord; mauto 2 | exact HA | exact HAA | exact HB ]. Qed.

Lemma wf_exp_eq_small_large : forall {Θ Ξ Γ A A' o i},
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A ≈ A' : Type⟨𝕃ᵒ o⟩ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A ≈ A' : Typeω@i.
Proof. intros; eapply wf_exp_eq_subtyp'; [ eassumption | eapply wf_subtyp_small_large; mauto 3 ]. Qed.

Lemma ctx_decomp : forall {Θ Ξ Γ A},
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹ A ->
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ /\ exists i, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A : Typeω@i.
Proof.
  inversion 1; eauto using presup_exp_ctx.
Qed.

#[export]
Hint Resolve ctx_decomp : mctt.

Corollary ctx_decomp_left : forall {Θ Ξ Γ A}, ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹ A -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ.
Proof.
  intros * ?%ctx_decomp; easy.
Qed.

Corollary ctx_decomp_right : forall {Θ Ξ Γ A}, ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹ A -> exists i, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A : Typeω@i.
Proof.
  intros * ?%ctx_decomp; easy.
Qed.

#[export]
Hint Resolve ctx_decomp_left ctx_decomp_right : mctt.

Lemma ctx_decomp_def : forall {Θ Ξ Γ A M},
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▸ A ≔ M ->
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ /\ (exists i, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A : Typeω@i) /\ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : A.
Proof.
  inversion 1; eauto using presup_exp_ctx.
Qed.

Corollary ctx_decomp_def_left : forall {Θ Ξ Γ A M}, ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▸ A ≔ M -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ.
Proof.
  intros * ?%ctx_decomp_def; easy.
Qed.

Corollary ctx_decomp_def_typ : forall {Θ Ξ Γ A M},
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▸ A ≔ M -> exists i, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A : Typeω@i.
Proof.
  intros * ?%ctx_decomp_def; easy.
Qed.

Corollary ctx_decomp_def_body : forall {Θ Ξ Γ A M},
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▸ A ≔ M -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : A.
Proof.
  intros * ?%ctx_decomp_def; easy.
Qed.

#[export]
Hint Resolve ctx_decomp_def_left ctx_decomp_def_typ ctx_decomp_def_body : mctt.

The tail of a well-formed context, whatever its head.
Corollary ctx_decomp_tail : forall {Θ Ξ Γ e}, ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ e :: Γ -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ.
Proof.
  intros * H; destruct e; eauto using ctx_decomp_left, ctx_decomp_def_left, ctx_decomp_mod_left.
Qed.

#[export]
Hint Resolve ctx_decomp_tail : mctt.

wf_wk, wf_sub and wf_sub_eq carry the well-formedness of both contexts. Rather than register the projections in mctt — which would let eauto chain them with the closure lemmas below and search for weakenings that do not exist — we saturate the context with them once, at the start of a proof that needs them.

Ltac saturate_wk :=
  match_by_head wf_wk ltac:(fun H => pose proof (wf_wk_dom _ _ _ _ _ H);
                                     pose proof (wf_wk_cod _ _ _ _ _ H));
  clear_dups.

Ltac saturate_sub :=
  match_by_head wf_sub ltac:(fun H => pose proof (wf_sub_dom _ _ _ _ _ H);
                                      pose proof (wf_sub_cod _ _ _ _ _ H));
  clear_dups.

Weakening Typing


Lemma wf_wk_id : forall Θ Ξ Γ, ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢w wk_id : Γ.
Proof.
  intros; econstructor; try eassumption;
    intros; rewrite ?exp_wk_id, ?gunit_wk_id; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma wf_wk_shift : forall Θ Ξ Γ e, ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ e :: Γ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ e :: Γ ⊢w ↑ : Γ.
Proof.
  intros * H; econstructor; [ eassumption | mauto 2 | | |];
    intros; simpl; mauto 2.
Qed.

Lifting a weakening over any entry: the lookups move along with it. The two contexts must be well formed; the rules below supply them.
Lemma wf_wk_q_gen : forall Θ Ξ Γ Δ φ e,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢w φ : Γ ->
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ centry_wk e φ :: Δ ->
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ e :: Γ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ centry_wk e φ :: Δ ⊢w wk_q φ : e :: Γ.
Proof.
  intros * Hφ ? ?.
  econstructor; [ assumption | assumption | | |].
  - intros x B Hlk; inversion Hlk; subst; simpl; rewrite exp_wk_shift_wk_q.
    + econstructor.
    + econstructor.
    + econstructor; eapply wf_wk_lookup; eassumption.
  - intros x B N Hlk.
    inversion Hlk; subst; simpl; rewrite !exp_wk_shift_wk_q; econstructor.
    eapply wf_wk_lookup_def; eassumption.
  - intros x U Hlk.
    inversion Hlk; subst; simpl; rewrite gunit_wk_shift_wk_q; econstructor.
    eapply wf_wk_lookup_mod; eassumption.
Qed.

The extra premise Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ A[φ]ʷ : Typeω@i is needed for ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ▹ A[φ]ʷ, it is exactly what the induction hypothesis of wk_preserves_wf supplies at every binder, and wf_sub_q states the corresponding premise for substitutions explicitly.
Lemma wf_wk_q : forall Θ Ξ Γ Δ φ A i,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢w φ : Γ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A : Typeω@i ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ A[φ]ʷ : Typeω@i ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ▹ A[φ]ʷ ⊢w wk_q φ : Γ ▹ A.
Proof.
  intros * Hφ ? ?; apply (wf_wk_q_gen _ _ _ _ _ (ce_ass A)); mauto 2.
Qed.

The same over a definition: the body is weakened along with its type.
Lemma wf_wk_q_def : forall Θ Ξ Γ Δ φ A M i,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢w φ : Γ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A : Typeω@i ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : A ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ A[φ]ʷ : Typeω@i ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ M[φ]ʷ : A[φ]ʷ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ▸ A[φ]ʷ ≔ M[φ]ʷ ⊢w wk_q φ : Γ ▸ A ≔ M.
Proof.
  intros * Hφ ? ? ? ?; apply (wf_wk_q_gen _ _ _ _ _ (ce_def A M)); mauto 2.
Qed.

The same over a module slot.
Lemma wf_wk_q_mod : forall Θ Ξ Γ Δ φ U,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢w φ : Γ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ U ≈ U ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ᵘ gunit_wk U φ ≈ gunit_wk U φ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ▹ₘ gunit_wk U φ ⊢w wk_q φ : Γ ▹ₘ U.
Proof.
  intros * Hφ ? ?; apply (wf_wk_q_gen _ _ _ _ _ (ce_mod U)); mauto 2.
Qed.

Lifting over a whole extension, given that both extended contexts are well formed.
Lemma wf_wk_ext : forall Θ Ξ Ψ Γ Δ φ,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢w φ : Γ ->
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ tele_wk Ψ φ ++ Δ ->
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Ψ ++ Γ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ tele_wk Ψ φ ++ Δ ⊢w wk_qn (length Ψ) φ : Ψ ++ Γ.
Proof.
  induction Ψ as [| e Ψ IH]; intros * Hφ HΔ HΓ; cbn in *; [ assumption |].
  apply wf_wk_q_gen; [ apply IH; eauto using ctx_decomp_tail | assumption | assumption ].
Qed.

Lemma wf_wk_compose : forall Θ Ξ Γ Δ Δ' φ ψ,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢w ψ : Δ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢w φ : Δ' ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢w φ ⊙ ψ : Δ'.
Proof.
  intros * Hψ Hφ; saturate_wk.
  econstructor; [ eassumption | eassumption | | |].
  - intros x B ?; simpl; rewrite <- exp_wk_wk.
    eapply wf_wk_lookup; [ eassumption | ].
    eapply wf_wk_lookup; eassumption.
  - intros x B N ?; simpl; rewrite <- !exp_wk_wk.
    eapply wf_wk_lookup_def; [ eassumption | ].
    eapply wf_wk_lookup_def; eassumption.
  - intros x U ?; simpl; rewrite <- gunit_wk_wk.
    eapply wf_wk_lookup_mod; [ eassumption | ].
    eapply wf_wk_lookup_mod; eassumption.
Qed.

#[export]
Hint Resolve wf_wk_id wf_wk_shift wf_wk_q wf_wk_q_def wf_wk_q_mod wf_wk_compose : mctt.

The same for ⊥, the binder of the ⊥-eliminator's motive.
Corollary wf_wk_q_False : forall Θ Ξ Γ Δ φ,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢w φ : Γ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ▹ ⊥ ⊢w wk_q φ : Γ ▹ ⊥.
Proof.
  intros * Hφ; saturate_wk.
  apply (wf_wk_q Θ Ξ Γ Δ φ ⊥ 0); simpl; mauto 2.
Qed.

#[export]
Hint Resolve wf_wk_q_False : mctt.

A weakening transports a variable by its defining property. Registering this — rather than wf_wk_lookup itself — as a hint keeps eauto away from the record projection, whose conclusion is a bare ctx_lookup and would let the search wander.
Lemma wk_preserves_vlookup : forall Θ Ξ Γ Δ φ x A,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢w φ : Γ ->
    Γ ∋ #x : A ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ #(φ x) : A[φ]ʷ.
Proof.
  intros * Hφ ?; saturate_wk.
  econstructor; [ eassumption | eapply wf_wk_lookup; eassumption ].
Qed.

Lemma wk_preserves_vlookup_eq : forall Θ Ξ Γ Δ φ x A,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢w φ : Γ ->
    Γ ∋ #x : A ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ #(φ x) ≈ #(φ x) : A[φ]ʷ.
Proof.
  intros * Hφ ?; saturate_wk.
  econstructor; [ eassumption | eapply wf_wk_lookup; eassumption ].
Qed.

δ moved along a weakening: the image of a definition is the same definition.
Lemma wk_preserves_vlookup_def : forall Θ Ξ Γ Δ φ x A M,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢w φ : Γ ->
    Γ ∋ #x ≔ M : A ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ #(φ x) ≈ M[φ]ʷ : A[φ]ʷ.
Proof.
  intros * Hφ ?; saturate_wk.
  eapply wf_exp_eq_var_delta; [ eassumption | eapply wf_wk_lookup_def; eassumption ].
Qed.

#[export]
Hint Resolve wk_preserves_vlookup wk_preserves_vlookup_eq wk_preserves_vlookup_def : mctt.

Pushing an Operation Inwards

Every type in an elimination rule is a substitution instance, so transporting a judgment along an operation produces a type with that operation on the outside, whereas the rule to be applied wants it on the inside. push_wk alternates simpl — which distributes a weakening over the term formers — with the corollaries of Substitution that move it past a substitution.
It has to normalise the induction hypotheses as well as the goal, and those are still universally quantified over the target context and the operation; plain rewrite does not descend under a binder, so setoid_rewrite is used throughout.
What a global resolves to is closed in a well-formed context (wf_gc_resolve_closed), so an operation on it vanishes, and the transported type and the type the rule wants coincide. It is a separate tactic rather than part of the sets below, because it applies in three cases only.

Ltac saturate_closed :=
  repeat match goal with
  | Hc : ⊢ ?Θ ⍮ ?Ξ ⍮ _, Hl : gc_resolve ?Θ ?Ξ _ = Some (ge_def _ _ ?A _) |- _ =>
      assert_fails (assert (exp_scoped 0 A) by eassumption);
      pose proof (wf_gc_resolve_type_closed _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hc Hl)
  | Hc : ⊢ ?Θ ⍮ ?Ξ ⍮ _, Hl : gc_resolve ?Θ ?Ξ _ = Some (ge_def _ _ _ (Some ?M)) |- _ =>
      assert_fails (assert (exp_scoped 0 M) by eassumption);
      pose proof (wf_gc_resolve_body_closed _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hc Hl)
  | Hc : ⊢ ?Θ ⍮ ?Ξ ⍮ _, Hl : ind_alias_lookup ?Θ ?Ξ _ = Some (?Δ, ?p, ?Ns), Hd : ind_lookup ?Θ ?Ξ ?p = Some ?D |- _ =>
      assert_fails (assert (exp_scoped 0 (ctx_pi Δ (ind_ty_at D Ns))) by eassumption);
      let Ha := fresh "Ha" in
      pose proof (wf_ind_alias_closed _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hc Hl Hd) as Ha; destruct Ha
  end.

Ltac push_closed :=
  saturate_closed;
  repeat match goal with
  | Hp : mod_qname ?H = Some _ |- context [ modexp_wk ?H ?φ ] => rewrite (mod_qname_wk H _ φ Hp)
  | Hp : mod_qname ?H = Some _ |- context [ modexp_sub ?H ?σ ] => rewrite (mod_qname_sub H _ σ Hp)
  | Hc : exp_scoped 0 ?X |- context [ exp_wk ?X ?φ ] => rewrite (exp_closed_wk X φ Hc)
  | Hc : exp_scoped 0 ?X |- context [ exp_sub ?X ?σ ] => rewrite (exp_closed_sub X σ Hc)
  end.

Ltac push_wk_step H :=
  first [ setoid_rewrite exp_wk_sub_extend in H
        | setoid_rewrite exp_wk_sub_extend2 in H
        | setoid_rewrite exp_wk_shift_wk_q in H ].

Ltac push_wk_in H :=
  try simpl in H; repeat (push_wk_step H; try simpl in H).

Ltac push_wk_goal :=
  try simpl;
  repeat (first [ setoid_rewrite exp_wk_sub_extend
                | setoid_rewrite exp_wk_sub_extend2
                | setoid_rewrite exp_wk_shift_wk_q ];
          try simpl).

The parentheses around on_all_hyp: are required, not cosmetic: its argument is parsed at tactic4, which already includes _ ; _, so an unparenthesised continuation is silently absorbed into the per-hypothesis tactic instead of running afterwards.
Ltac push_wk :=
  (on_all_hyp: (fun H => try push_wk_in H));
  push_wk_goal.

Saturating with the Lifted Weakenings

Every binder case of wk_preserves_wf needs the lifted weakening Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ▹ A[φ]ʷ ⊢w q φ : Γ ▹ A before the induction hypothesis for the body can be used. It is derivable — wf_wk_q is a hint — but only from the induction hypothesis for the domain, so leaving it to eauto costs three extra levels of search on top of the rule application, which puts the wider cases (λ-E) out of reach at any depth that terminates. Adding each lifted weakening to the context up front costs one assert instead.
lift_wk_False seeds the ⊥-eliminator case, whose binder is over the closed type ⊥: lift_wk_step cannot start there, because the domain of that binder has no induction hypothesis of its own. It is guarded by the presence of a motive Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹ ⊥ ⊢ A : Typeω@i.

Ltac lift_wk_False :=
  match goal with
  | _ : wf_exp ?Θ ?Ξ (cons (ce_ass a_False) ?Γ) (a_typ _) _, Hφ : wf_wk ?Θ ?Ξ ?Δ ?Γ ?φ |- _ =>
      let T := constr:(wf_wk Θ Ξ (cons (ce_ass a_False) Δ) (cons (ce_ass a_False) Γ) (wk_q φ)) in
      assert_fails (assert T by assumption);
      assert T by (apply wf_wk_q_False; exact Hφ)
  end.

Ltac lift_wk_step :=
  match goal with
  | Hφ : wf_wk ?Θ ?Ξ ?Δ ?Γ ?φ,
    IH : forall _ _, wf_wk ?Θ ?Ξ _ ?Γ _ -> wf_exp ?Θ ?Ξ _ (a_typ _) (exp_wk ?A _) |- _ =>
      let T := constr:(wf_wk Θ Ξ (cons (ce_ass (exp_wk A φ)) Δ) (cons (ce_ass A) Γ) (wk_q φ)) in
      assert_fails (assert T by assumption);
      assert T by (eapply wf_wk_q; [ exact Hφ | | exact (IH _ _ Hφ) ]; mauto 2)
  | Hφ : wf_wk ?Θ ?Ξ ?Δ ?Γ ?φ,
    IH : forall _ _, wf_wk ?Θ ?Ξ _ ?Γ _ -> wf_exp ?Θ ?Ξ _ (a_univ _) (exp_wk ?A _) |- _ =>
      let T := constr:(wf_wk Θ Ξ (cons (ce_ass (exp_wk A φ)) Δ) (cons (ce_ass A) Γ) (wk_q φ)) in
      assert_fails (assert T by assumption);
      assert T by (eapply (wf_wk_q _ _ _ _ _ _ 0); [ exact Hφ | | exact (wf_exp_small_large (IH _ _ Hφ)) ];
                   eapply wf_exp_small_large; eassumption)
  end.

The lifted weakening over a definition, for the let rules. It is built only where an induction hypothesis lives in the extended context.
Ltac lift_wk_def :=
  match goal with
  | Hφ : wf_wk ?Θ ?Ξ ?Δ ?Γ ?φ,
    _ : forall _ _, wf_wk ?Θ ?Ξ _ (cons (ce_def ?A ?M) ?Γ) _ -> _,
    IHA : forall _ _, wf_wk ?Θ ?Ξ _ ?Γ _ -> wf_exp ?Θ ?Ξ _ (a_typ _) (exp_wk ?A _),
    IHM : forall _ _, wf_wk ?Θ ?Ξ _ ?Γ _ -> wf_exp ?Θ ?Ξ _ (exp_wk ?A _) (exp_wk ?M _) |- _ =>
      let T := constr:(wf_wk Θ Ξ (cons (ce_def (exp_wk A φ) (exp_wk M φ)) Δ) (cons (ce_def A M) Γ) (wk_q φ)) in
      assert_fails (assert T by assumption);
      assert T by (eapply wf_wk_q_def; [ exact Hφ | | | exact (IHA _ _ Hφ) | exact (IHM _ _ Hφ) ]; mauto 2)
  end.

Ltac lift_wk := repeat first [ lift_wk_False | lift_wk_step | lift_wk_def ].

Facts about Modules for the Transport Lemmas


Lemma ext_eq_ctx : forall Θ Ξ Γ Ψ Ψ',
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ Ψ ≈ Ψ' -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Ψ ++ Γ /\ ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Ψ' ++ Γ.
Proof.
  induction 1; cbn; split; destruct_all; mauto 3 using wf_unit_eq_refl_left.
Qed.

Lemma ext_eq_ctx_left : forall Θ Ξ Γ Ψ Ψ', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ Ψ ≈ Ψ' -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Ψ ++ Γ.
Proof. intros * H; exact (proj1 (ext_eq_ctx _ _ _ _ _ H)). Qed.

Lemma ext_eq_ctx_right : forall Θ Ξ Γ Ψ Ψ', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ Ψ ≈ Ψ' -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Ψ' ++ Γ.
Proof. intros * H; exact (proj2 (ext_eq_ctx _ _ _ _ _ H)). Qed.

#[export]
Hint Resolve ext_eq_ctx_left ext_eq_ctx_right : mctt.

The tail of a well-formed context Ψ ++ Γ.
Lemma ctx_app_wf_tail : forall Θ Ξ Ψ Γ, ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Ψ ++ Γ -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ.
Proof. induction Ψ; intros; cbn in *; eauto using ctx_decomp_tail. Qed.

The motive's and the branches' contexts are of assumptions.
Lemma ihs_ctx_aux_ass : forall D A Us na gs pat j, tele_ass (ihs_ctx_aux D A Us na pat j gs).
Proof.
  induction gs as [| [] gs IH]; intros; cbn; [ constructor | apply IH |].
  apply List.Forall_app; split; [ apply IH | constructor; eauto ].
Qed.

Lemma elim_mctx_ass : forall p D Us, decl_closed D -> tele_ass (elim_mctx p D Us).
Proof. intros * HD; unfold elim_mctx; constructor; [ eauto | apply tele_ass_sub, decl_closed_nparams_ass, HD ]. Qed.

Lemma elim_bctx_ass : forall p D gs A Us, decl_closed D -> tele_ass (elim_bctx p D gs A Us).
Proof.
  intros * HD; unfold elim_bctx; apply List.Forall_app; split; [ apply ihs_ctx_aux_ass |].
  apply List.Forall_app; split; apply tele_ass_sub; [ apply cargs_ctx_aux_ass | apply decl_closed_nparams_ass, HD ].
Qed.

Lemma body_shape_wk : forall Φ Φ' φ φ', body_shape Φ Φ' -> body_shape (gmod_wk Φ φ) (gmod_wk Φ' φ').
Proof.
  induction Φ as [| Φ IH x E | Φ IH c its]; intros [| Φ' x' E' | Φ' c' its'] * Hs; cbn in *; try contradiction; auto.
  - destruct Hs as (Hs & -> & HE); repeat split; auto.
    destruct E as [? ? ? [] | | | ], E' as [? ? ? [] | | | ]; cbn in *; auto.
  - destruct Hs as (Hs & ->); split; auto.
Qed.

Lemma body_shape_sub : forall Φ Φ' σ σ', body_shape Φ Φ' -> body_shape (gmod_sub Φ σ) (gmod_sub Φ' σ').
Proof.
  induction Φ as [| Φ IH x E | Φ IH c its]; intros [| Φ' x' E' | Φ' c' its'] * Hs; cbn in *; try contradiction; auto.
  - destruct Hs as (Hs & -> & HE); repeat split; auto.
    destruct E as [? ? ? [] | | | ], E' as [? ? ? [] | | | ]; cbn in *; auto.
  - destruct Hs as (Hs & ->); split; auto.
Qed.

Lemma exp_wk_sub_extend_mod : forall M H φ,
    M[Id ,,ₘ H][φ]ʷ = M[wk_q φ]ʷ[Id ,,ₘ modexp_wk H φ].
Proof.
  intros; rewrite exp_wk_sub, exp_sub_wk; apply exp_sub_sb_eq; intros [| x]; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma exp_sub_sub_extend_mod : forall M H σ,
    M[Id ,,ₘ H][σ] = M[q σ][Id ,,ₘ H[σ]ᵐ].
Proof.
  intros; rewrite exp_sub_extend_mod_sub, exp_sub_q_extend_mod; reflexivity.
Qed.

A well-typed weakening sends module slots to slots of the same unit, and a well-typed substitution sends them to the same unit.
Lemma wf_wk_mod_compat : forall Θ Ξ Γ Δ φ, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢w φ : Γ -> wk_mod_compat φ Δ Γ.
Proof. intros * Hφ x U HU; eapply wf_wk_lookup_mod; eassumption. Qed.

Lemma wf_sub_mod_compat : forall Θ Ξ Γ Δ σ, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢s σ : Γ -> sub_mod_compat σ Δ Γ.
Proof.
  intros * Hσ x U HU; destruct (wf_sub_apply_mod _ _ _ _ _ Hσ _ _ HU) as [[? _] | ?]; [ left | right ]; assumption.
Qed.

#[export]
Hint Resolve wf_wk_mod_compat wf_sub_mod_compat : mctt.

Lemma ext_eq_length : forall Θ Ξ Γ Ψ Ψ', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ Ψ ≈ Ψ' -> length Ψ = length Ψ'.
Proof. induction 1; cbn; auto. Qed.

The lifted weakening into an extension, from the judgments about it.
Lemma wf_wk_ext_of_ext : forall Θ Ξ Γ Ψ Ψ' Δ φ,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢w φ : Γ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ Ψ ≈ Ψ' ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ˣ tele_wk Ψ φ ≈ tele_wk Ψ' φ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ tele_wk Ψ φ ++ Δ ⊢w wk_qn (length Ψ) φ : Ψ ++ Γ /\
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ tele_wk Ψ' φ ++ Δ ⊢w wk_qn (length Ψ') φ : Ψ' ++ Γ.
Proof.
  intros * Hφ HΨ HΨφ; split; apply wf_wk_ext; eauto using ext_eq_ctx_left, ext_eq_ctx_right.
Qed.

Weakening the Eliminator

The cases of the eliminator, with the induction hypotheses as premises. The declaration is closed, so the types of the parameters and arguments move with the terms they are instantiated at; the motive and the branches move under the binders their contexts add, which are well formed by the telescope premises.

Lemma wk_elim_params : forall Θ Ξ Γ Δ φ D Ps,
    decl_closed D ->
    (forall k P T, List.nth_error Ps k = Some P -> List.nth_error (tele_insts (ind_params D) Id Ps) k = Some T ->
       forall Δ0 φ0, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢w φ0 : Γ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢ P[φ0]ʷ : T[φ0]ʷ) ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢w φ : Γ ->
    forall k P T, List.nth_error (List.map (fun P => P[φ]ʷ) Ps) k = Some P ->
      List.nth_error (tele_insts (ind_params D) Id (List.map (fun P => P[φ]ʷ) Ps)) k = Some T ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ P : T.
Proof.
  intros * HD IH Hφ k P' T' HP HT.
  rewrite <- params_insts_wk in HT by exact HD.
  apply nth_error_map_inv in HP as (P & HP & ->); apply nth_error_map_inv in HT as (T & HT & ->).
  eauto.
Qed.

Lemma wk_elim_cargs : forall Θ Ξ Γ Δ φ p D c gs Ps As,
    decl_closed D -> ind_con D c = Some gs -> List.length Ps = ind_np D ->
    (forall k N T, List.nth_error As k = Some N ->
       List.nth_error (tele_insts (cargs_ctx p D gs) (sb_of_list Id Ps) As) k = Some T ->
       forall Δ0 φ0, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢w φ0 : Γ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢ N[φ0]ʷ : T[φ0]ʷ) ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢w φ : Γ ->
    forall k N T, List.nth_error (List.map (fun N => N[φ]ʷ) As) k = Some N ->
      List.nth_error (tele_insts (cargs_ctx p D gs) (sb_of_list Id (List.map (fun P => P[φ]ʷ) Ps))
                        (List.map (fun N => N[φ]ʷ) As)) k = Some T ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ N : T.
Proof.
  intros * HD Hc Hl IH Hφ k N' T' HN HT.
  erewrite <- cargs_insts_wk in HT by eassumption.
  apply nth_error_map_inv in HN as (N & HN & ->); apply nth_error_map_inv in HT as (T & HT & ->).
  eauto.
Qed.

Lemma wk_elim_motive_ctx : forall Θ Ξ Γ Δ φ p D Us,
    decl_closed D -> List.length Us = ind_nu D ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢w φ : Γ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ elim_mctx p D Us ≈ elim_mctx p D Us ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ˣ tele_wk (elim_mctx p D Us) φ ≈ tele_wk (elim_mctx p D Us) φ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ elim_mctx p D (List.map (fun U => U[φ]ʷ) Us) ++ Δ ⊢w wk_qn (S (ind_nn D)) φ : elim_mctx p D Us ++ Γ.
Proof.
  intros * HD Hl Hφ HΨ HΨφ.
  rewrite <- elim_mctx_wk by assumption; rewrite <- (length_elim_mctx p D Us).
  apply wf_wk_ext; eauto using ext_eq_ctx_left.
Qed.

Lemma wk_elim_branch_ctx : forall Θ Ξ Γ Δ φ p D c gs A Us,
    decl_closed D -> List.In (c, gs) (ind_cons D) -> List.length Us = ind_nu D ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢w φ : Γ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ elim_bctx p D gs A Us ≈ elim_bctx p D gs A Us ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ˣ tele_wk (elim_bctx p D gs A Us) φ ≈ tele_wk (elim_bctx p D gs A Us) φ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ elim_bctx p D gs A[wk_qn (S (ind_nn D)) φ]ʷ (List.map (fun U => U[φ]ʷ) Us) ++ Δ
      ⊢w wk_qn (ind_nn D + List.length gs + cargs_nrec gs) φ : elim_bctx p D gs A Us ++ Γ.
Proof.
  intros * HD Hin Hl Hφ HΨ HΨφ.
  erewrite <- elim_bctx_wk by eassumption.
  replace (ind_nn D + List.length gs + cargs_nrec gs) with (List.length (elim_bctx p D gs A Us)) by (rewrite length_elim_bctx; lia).
  apply wf_wk_ext; eauto using ext_eq_ctx_left.
Qed.

Lemma wk_firstn_length : forall D (Ps : list typ),
    decl_closed D -> List.length Ps = ind_np D -> List.length (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps) = ind_nu D.
Proof. intros * HD Hl; rewrite List.length_firstn; pose proof (decl_closed_nu D HD); lia. Qed.

Lemma wk_apps_ind : forall p Ps φ, (apps (a_ind p) Ps)[φ]ʷ = apps (a_ind p) (List.map (fun P => P[φ]ʷ) Ps).
Proof. intros; rewrite apps_exp_wk; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma wk_apps_con : forall p c Ps φ, (apps (a_con p c) Ps)[φ]ʷ = apps (a_con p c) (List.map (fun P => P[φ]ʷ) Ps).
Proof. intros; rewrite apps_exp_wk; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma wk_elim_type : forall D Ps A M nm φ,
    List.length Ps = ind_np D -> nm = S (ind_nn D) ->
    (A[sb_of_list Id (List.skipn (ind_nu D) Ps ++ M :: nil)])[φ]ʷ
    = A[wk_qn nm φ]ʷ[sb_of_list Id (List.skipn (ind_nu D) (List.map (fun P => P[φ]ʷ) Ps) ++ M[φ]ʷ :: nil)].
Proof.
  intros * Hl Hnm; rewrite exp_wk_sb_of_list, List.map_app, List.skipn_map; cbn [List.map].
  rewrite List.length_app, List.length_skipn; cbn; subst; unfold ind_nn; do 3 f_equal; lia.
Qed.

Lemma wk_elim_scrut_case : forall Θ Ξ Γ Δ φ p D Ps Ps' N nm i A Bs,
    ind_lookup Θ Ξ p = Some D ->
    List.length Ps = ind_np D ->
    (forall k P T, List.nth_error Ps k = Some P -> List.nth_error (tele_insts (ind_params D) Id Ps) k = Some T ->
       forall Δ0 φ0, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢w φ0 : Γ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢ P[φ0]ʷ : T[φ0]ʷ) ->
    nm = S (ind_nn D) ->
    (forall Δ0 φ0, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢w φ0 : elim_mctx p D (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps) ++ Γ ->
       Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢ A[φ0]ʷ : Typeω@i[φ0]ʷ) ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ elim_mctx p D (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps) ≈ elim_mctx p D (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps) ->
    (forall Δ0 φ0, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢w φ0 : Γ ->
       Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢ˣ tele_wk (elim_mctx p D (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) φ0
         ≈ tele_wk (elim_mctx p D (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) φ0) ->
    brs_names (ind_cons D) Bs ->
    (forall c gs, ind_con D c = Some gs ->
       Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ elim_bctx p D gs A (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps) ≈ elim_bctx p D gs A (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) ->
    (forall c gs, ind_con D c = Some gs -> forall Δ0 φ0, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢w φ0 : Γ ->
       Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢ˣ tele_wk (elim_bctx p D gs A (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) φ0
         ≈ tele_wk (elim_bctx p D gs A (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) φ0) ->
    (forall c gs n B, ind_con D c = Some gs -> List.In (c, n, B) Bs -> n = (ind_nn D + List.length gs + cargs_nrec gs)%nat) ->
    (forall c gs n B, ind_con D c = Some gs -> List.In (c, n, B) Bs ->
       forall Δ0 φ0, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢w φ0 : elim_bctx p D gs A (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps) ++ Γ ->
       Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢ B[φ0]ʷ : (elim_bty p D c gs A (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps))[φ0]ʷ) ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢w φ : Γ ->
    List.length Ps' = ind_np D -> List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps' = List.map (fun P => P[φ]ʷ) (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps) ->
    (forall k P T, List.nth_error Ps' k = Some P -> List.nth_error (tele_insts (ind_params D) Id Ps') k = Some T ->
       Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ P : T) ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ N : apps (a_ind p) Ps' ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ a_elim nm A[wk_qn nm φ]ʷ (brs_wk Bs φ) N
      : A[wk_qn nm φ]ʷ[sb_of_list Id (List.skipn (ind_nu D) Ps' ++ N :: nil)].
Proof.
  intros * Hl HPl HPs Hnm HA HΨ HΨφ Hn HΨB HΨBφ Hk HB Hφ HPl' HPu HPs' HN.
  assert (HD : decl_closed D) by (eapply gctx_closed_ind; [ eapply wf_gctx_closed, (wf_wk_dom _ _ _ _ _ Hφ) | exact Hl ]).
  pose proof (wk_firstn_length D Ps HD HPl) as HUl.
  subst nm.
  eapply wf_elim with (Ps := Ps').
  - exact Hl.
  - exact HPl'.
  - exact HPs'.
  - exact HN.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite HPu; exact (HA _ _ (wk_elim_motive_ctx _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HD HUl Hφ HΨ (HΨφ _ _ Hφ))).
  - rewrite HPu, <- elim_mctx_wk by assumption; apply HΨφ; exact Hφ.
  - apply brs_names_map; exact Hn.
  - intros c gs Hc; rewrite HPu, <- (elim_bctx_wk p D c gs A _ φ HD (cons_lookup_in _ _ _ Hc) HUl); apply (HΨBφ c gs Hc); assumption.
  - intros c gs n B' Hc Hin; apply brs_in_map in Hin as (B & Hin & ->); eapply Hk; eassumption.
  - intros c gs n B' Hc Hin; apply brs_in_map in Hin as (B & Hin & ->); cbn [fst snd].
    rewrite HPu, <- elim_bty_wk, (Hk _ _ _ _ Hc Hin).
    apply (HB c gs n B Hc Hin).
    apply (wk_elim_branch_ctx _ _ _ _ _ _ _ c); eauto using cons_lookup_in.
Qed.

Lemma wk_elim_case : forall Θ Ξ Γ Δ φ p D Ps M nm i A Bs,
    ind_lookup Θ Ξ p = Some D ->
    List.length Ps = ind_np D ->
    (forall k P T, List.nth_error Ps k = Some P -> List.nth_error (tele_insts (ind_params D) Id Ps) k = Some T ->
       forall Δ0 φ0, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢w φ0 : Γ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢ P[φ0]ʷ : T[φ0]ʷ) ->
    (forall Δ0 φ0, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢w φ0 : Γ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢ M[φ0]ʷ : (apps (a_ind p) Ps)[φ0]ʷ) ->
    nm = S (ind_nn D) ->
    (forall Δ0 φ0, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢w φ0 : elim_mctx p D (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps) ++ Γ ->
       Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢ A[φ0]ʷ : Typeω@i[φ0]ʷ) ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ elim_mctx p D (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps) ≈ elim_mctx p D (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps) ->
    (forall Δ0 φ0, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢w φ0 : Γ ->
       Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢ˣ tele_wk (elim_mctx p D (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) φ0
         ≈ tele_wk (elim_mctx p D (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) φ0) ->
    brs_names (ind_cons D) Bs ->
    (forall c gs, ind_con D c = Some gs ->
       Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ elim_bctx p D gs A (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps) ≈ elim_bctx p D gs A (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) ->
    (forall c gs, ind_con D c = Some gs -> forall Δ0 φ0, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢w φ0 : Γ ->
       Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢ˣ tele_wk (elim_bctx p D gs A (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) φ0
         ≈ tele_wk (elim_bctx p D gs A (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) φ0) ->
    (forall c gs n B, ind_con D c = Some gs -> List.In (c, n, B) Bs -> n = (ind_nn D + List.length gs + cargs_nrec gs)%nat) ->
    (forall c gs n B, ind_con D c = Some gs -> List.In (c, n, B) Bs ->
       forall Δ0 φ0, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢w φ0 : elim_bctx p D gs A (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps) ++ Γ ->
       Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢ B[φ0]ʷ : (elim_bty p D c gs A (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps))[φ0]ʷ) ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢w φ : Γ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ (a_elim nm A Bs M)[φ]ʷ : (A[sb_of_list Id (List.skipn (ind_nu D) Ps ++ M :: nil)])[φ]ʷ.
Proof.
  intros * Hl HPl HPs HM Hnm HA HΨ HΨφ Hn HΨB HΨBφ Hk HB Hφ.
  rewrite (wk_elim_type D Ps A M nm φ HPl Hnm); cbn [exp_wk].
  assert (HD : decl_closed D) by (eapply gctx_closed_ind; [ eapply wf_gctx_closed, (wf_wk_dom _ _ _ _ _ Hφ) | exact Hl ]).
  eapply wk_elim_scrut_case; try eassumption.
  - rewrite List.length_map; exact HPl.
  - apply List.firstn_map.
  - eapply wk_elim_params; eassumption.
  - rewrite <- wk_apps_ind; apply HM; exact Hφ.
Qed.

Lemma wk_elim_cong_case : forall Θ Ξ Γ Δ φ p D Ps M M' nm i A A' Bs Bs',
    ind_lookup Θ Ξ p = Some D ->
    List.length Ps = ind_np D ->
    (forall k P T, List.nth_error Ps k = Some P -> List.nth_error (tele_insts (ind_params D) Id Ps) k = Some T ->
       forall Δ0 φ0, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢w φ0 : Γ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢ P[φ0]ʷ : T[φ0]ʷ) ->
    (forall Δ0 φ0, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢w φ0 : Γ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢ M[φ0]ʷ ≈ M'[φ0]ʷ : (apps (a_ind p) Ps)[φ0]ʷ) ->
    nm = S (ind_nn D) ->
    (forall Δ0 φ0, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢w φ0 : elim_mctx p D (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps) ++ Γ ->
       Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢ A[φ0]ʷ : Typeω@i[φ0]ʷ) ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ elim_mctx p D (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps) ≈ elim_mctx p D (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps) ->
    (forall Δ0 φ0, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢w φ0 : Γ ->
       Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢ˣ tele_wk (elim_mctx p D (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) φ0
         ≈ tele_wk (elim_mctx p D (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) φ0) ->
    (forall Δ0 φ0, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢w φ0 : elim_mctx p D (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps) ++ Γ ->
       Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢ A[φ0]ʷ ≈ A'[φ0]ʷ : Typeω@i[φ0]ʷ) ->
    brs_names (ind_cons D) Bs ->
    (forall c gs, ind_con D c = Some gs ->
       Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ elim_bctx p D gs A (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps) ≈ elim_bctx p D gs A (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) ->
    (forall c gs, ind_con D c = Some gs -> forall Δ0 φ0, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢w φ0 : Γ ->
       Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢ˣ tele_wk (elim_bctx p D gs A (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) φ0
         ≈ tele_wk (elim_bctx p D gs A (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) φ0) ->
    List.map fst Bs = List.map fst Bs' ->
    (forall c gs n B, ind_con D c = Some gs -> List.In (c, n, B) Bs -> n = (ind_nn D + List.length gs + cargs_nrec gs)%nat) ->
    (forall k c gs n B B', List.nth_error Bs k = Some (c, n, B) -> List.nth_error Bs' k = Some (c, n, B') ->
       ind_con D c = Some gs ->
       forall Δ0 φ0, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢w φ0 : elim_bctx p D gs A (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps) ++ Γ ->
       Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢ B[φ0]ʷ ≈ B'[φ0]ʷ : (elim_bty p D c gs A (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps))[φ0]ʷ) ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢w φ : Γ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ (a_elim nm A Bs M)[φ]ʷ ≈ (a_elim nm A' Bs' M')[φ]ʷ
      : (A[sb_of_list Id (List.skipn (ind_nu D) Ps ++ M :: nil)])[φ]ʷ.
Proof.
  intros * Hl HPl HPs HM Hnm HA HΨ HΨφ HAA Hn HΨB HΨBφ Hf Hk HB Hφ.
  assert (HD : decl_closed D) by (eapply gctx_closed_ind; [ eapply wf_gctx_closed, (wf_wk_dom _ _ _ _ _ Hφ) | exact Hl ]).
  pose proof (wk_firstn_length D Ps HD HPl) as HUl.
  pose proof (wk_elim_motive_ctx _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HD HUl Hφ HΨ (HΨφ _ _ Hφ)) as Hq.
  rewrite (wk_elim_type D Ps A M nm φ HPl Hnm); cbn [exp_wk]; subst nm.
  eapply wf_exp_eq_elim_cong with (Ps := List.map (fun P => P[φ]ʷ) Ps).
  - exact Hl.
  - rewrite List.length_map; exact HPl.
  - eapply wk_elim_params; eassumption.
  - rewrite <- wk_apps_ind; apply HM; exact Hφ.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite List.firstn_map; exact (HA _ _ Hq).
  - rewrite List.firstn_map, <- elim_mctx_wk by assumption; apply HΨφ; exact Hφ.
  - rewrite List.firstn_map; exact (HAA _ _ Hq).
  - apply brs_names_map; exact Hn.
  - intros c gs Hc; rewrite List.firstn_map, <- (elim_bctx_wk p D c gs A _ φ HD (cons_lookup_in _ _ _ Hc) HUl).
    apply (HΨBφ c gs Hc); assumption.
  - rewrite !brs_fst_map; exact Hf.
  - intros c gs n B' Hc Hin; apply brs_in_map in Hin as (B & Hin & ->); eapply Hk; eassumption.
  - intros k c gs n B1 B2 Hk1 Hk2 Hc.
    apply nth_error_map_inv in Hk1 as ([[c1 n1] B] & Hk1 & Heq1); cbn in Heq1; injection Heq1 as <- <- ->.
    apply nth_error_map_inv in Hk2 as ([[c2 n2] B'] & Hk2 & Heq2); cbn in Heq2; injection Heq2 as <- <- ->.
    cbn [fst snd]; pose proof (List.nth_error_In _ _ Hk1) as Hin.
    rewrite List.firstn_map, <- elim_bty_wk, (Hk _ _ _ _ Hc Hin).
    apply (HB k c gs n B B' Hk1 Hk2 Hc).
    apply (wk_elim_branch_ctx _ _ _ _ _ _ _ c); eauto using cons_lookup_in.
Qed.

Lemma wk_elim_iota_case : forall Θ Ξ Γ Δ φ p D c gs Ps As nm i A Bs n B,
    ind_lookup Θ Ξ p = Some D ->
    ind_con D c = Some gs ->
    List.length Ps = ind_np D ->
    (forall k P T, List.nth_error Ps k = Some P -> List.nth_error (tele_insts (ind_params D) Id Ps) k = Some T ->
       forall Δ0 φ0, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢w φ0 : Γ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢ P[φ0]ʷ : T[φ0]ʷ) ->
    List.length As = List.length gs ->
    (forall k N T, List.nth_error As k = Some N ->
       List.nth_error (tele_insts (cargs_ctx p D gs) (sb_of_list Id Ps) As) k = Some T ->
       forall Δ0 φ0, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢w φ0 : Γ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢ N[φ0]ʷ : T[φ0]ʷ) ->
    nm = S (ind_nn D) ->
    (forall Δ0 φ0, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢w φ0 : elim_mctx p D (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps) ++ Γ ->
       Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢ A[φ0]ʷ : Typeω@i[φ0]ʷ) ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ elim_mctx p D (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps) ≈ elim_mctx p D (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps) ->
    (forall Δ0 φ0, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢w φ0 : Γ ->
       Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢ˣ tele_wk (elim_mctx p D (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) φ0
         ≈ tele_wk (elim_mctx p D (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) φ0) ->
    brs_names (ind_cons D) Bs ->
    (forall c gs, ind_con D c = Some gs ->
       Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ elim_bctx p D gs A (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps) ≈ elim_bctx p D gs A (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) ->
    (forall c gs, ind_con D c = Some gs -> forall Δ0 φ0, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢w φ0 : Γ ->
       Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢ˣ tele_wk (elim_bctx p D gs A (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) φ0
         ≈ tele_wk (elim_bctx p D gs A (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) φ0) ->
    (forall c gs n B, ind_con D c = Some gs -> List.In (c, n, B) Bs -> n = (ind_nn D + List.length gs + cargs_nrec gs)%nat) ->
    (forall c gs n B, ind_con D c = Some gs -> List.In (c, n, B) Bs ->
       forall Δ0 φ0, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢w φ0 : elim_bctx p D gs A (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps) ++ Γ ->
       Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢ B[φ0]ʷ : (elim_bty p D c gs A (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps))[φ0]ʷ) ->
    brs_lookup Bs c = Some (n, B) ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢w φ : Γ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ (a_elim nm A Bs (apps (a_con p c) (Ps ++ As)))[φ]ʷ
      ≈ (B[sb_of_list Id (List.skipn (ind_nu D) Ps ++ As ++ elim_ihs nm A Bs (sb_of_list Id Ps) gs As)])[φ]ʷ
      : (A[sb_of_list Id (List.skipn (ind_nu D) Ps ++ apps (a_con p c) (Ps ++ As) :: nil)])[φ]ʷ.
Proof.
  intros * Hl Hc HPl HPs HAl HAs Hnm HA HΨ HΨφ Hn HΨB HΨBφ Hk HB HlB Hφ.
  assert (HD : decl_closed D) by (eapply gctx_closed_ind; [ eapply wf_gctx_closed, (wf_wk_dom _ _ _ _ _ Hφ) | exact Hl ]).
  pose proof (wk_firstn_length D Ps HD HPl) as HUl.
  pose proof (brs_lookup_in _ _ _ _ HlB) as HinB.
  rewrite (wk_elim_type D Ps A _ nm φ HPl Hnm), exp_wk_sb_of_list; cbn [exp_wk].
  rewrite !List.map_app, wk_apps_con, List.map_app, (elim_ihs_wk_inst D c gs) by eauto using cons_lookup_in.
  rewrite <- List.skipn_map.
  replace (List.length (List.skipn (ind_nu D) Ps ++ As ++ elim_ihs nm A Bs (sb_of_list Id Ps) gs As))
    with n by (rewrite !List.length_app, List.length_skipn, length_elim_ihs by assumption;
               rewrite (Hk _ _ _ _ Hc HinB); unfold ind_nn; lia).
  subst nm.
  eapply wf_exp_eq_elim_iota with (Ps := List.map (fun P => P[φ]ʷ) Ps) (As := List.map (fun N => N[φ]ʷ) As)
                                  (B := B[wk_qn n φ]ʷ) (n := n).
  - exact (wf_wk_dom _ _ _ _ _ Hφ).
  - exact Hl.
  - exact Hc.
  - rewrite List.length_map; exact HPl.
  - eapply wk_elim_params; eassumption.
  - rewrite !List.length_map; exact HAl.
  - eapply wk_elim_cargs; eassumption.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite List.firstn_map; exact (HA _ _ (wk_elim_motive_ctx _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HD HUl Hφ HΨ (HΨφ _ _ Hφ))).
  - rewrite List.firstn_map, <- elim_mctx_wk by assumption; apply HΨφ; exact Hφ.
  - apply brs_names_map; exact Hn.
  - intros c' gs' Hc'; rewrite List.firstn_map, <- (elim_bctx_wk p D c' gs' A _ φ HD (cons_lookup_in _ _ _ Hc') HUl).
    apply (HΨBφ c' gs' Hc'); assumption.
  - intros c' gs' n' B' Hc' Hin; apply brs_in_map in Hin as (B0 & Hin & ->); eapply Hk; eassumption.
  - intros c' gs' n' B' Hc' Hin; apply brs_in_map in Hin as (B0 & Hin & ->); cbn [fst snd].
    rewrite List.firstn_map, <- elim_bty_wk, (Hk _ _ _ _ Hc' Hin).
    apply (HB c' gs' n' B0 Hc' Hin).
    apply (wk_elim_branch_ctx _ _ _ _ _ _ _ c'); eauto using cons_lookup_in.
  - exact (brs_lookup_map (fun b => (snd b)[wk_qn (snd (fst b)) φ]ʷ) _ _ _ _ HlB).
Qed.

Bodies with Local Opens


Lemma wf_ctx_app_tail : forall Θ Ξ Ψ Γ, ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Ψ ++ Γ -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ.
Proof. induction Ψ; intros * H; cbn in *; [ assumption | apply IHΨ; eapply ctx_decomp_tail; exact H ]. Qed.

Lemma body_shape_binders : forall Φ Φ', body_shape Φ Φ' -> gm_binders Φ = gm_binders Φ'.
Proof.
  induction Φ as [| Φ IH y E | Φ IH c its]; intros [| Φ' y' E' | Φ' c' its'] Hs; cbn in *; try contradiction; auto.
  - destruct Hs as (Hs & _ & _); f_equal; auto.
  - destruct Hs as (Hs & ->); f_equal; auto.
Qed.

The opens of two bodies of the same shape stand after prefixes binding as many indices.
Lemma body_opens_lengths : forall Θ Ξ Γ Φ Φx, body_xp Θ Ξ Γ Φ Φx ->
    forall Γ' Φ' Φx' k Ψ H Ψ' H', body_xp Θ Ξ Γ' Φ' Φx' -> body_shape Φ Φ' ->
    List.nth_error (body_opens Φ Φx) k = Some (Ψ, H) -> List.nth_error (body_opens Φ' Φx') k = Some (Ψ', H') ->
    length Ψ = length Ψ'.
Proof.
  induction 1 as [| Γ Φ Φx x E Hx IH | Γ Φ Φx H0 its R T gs Hx IH _ _ Hg]; intros * Hx' Hs Hk Hk'.
  - destruct k; discriminate.
  - destruct Φ' as [| Φ1 x1 E1 | Φ1 Hm1 its1]; cbn in Hs; try contradiction; destruct Hs as (Hs & _ & _).
    inversion Hx'; subst; cbn [body_opens gm_dropn] in Hk, Hk'; eauto.
  - destruct Φ' as [| Φ1 x1 E1 | Φ1 Hm1 its1]; cbn in Hs; try contradiction; destruct Hs as (Hs & <-).
    inversion Hx'; subst.
    rewrite (body_opens_open _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hg) in Hk.
    match goal with Hg' : items_gen _ _ _ _ _ its _ |- _ => rewrite (body_opens_open _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hg') in Hk' end.
    destruct k as [| k]; cbn in Hk, Hk'; [| eauto ].
    injection Hk as <- <-; injection Hk' as <- <-.
    rewrite !length_body_ctx, (body_xp_binders _ _ _ _ _ Hx).
    match goal with Hx1 : body_xp _ _ _ Φ1 _ |- _ => rewrite (body_xp_binders _ _ _ _ _ Hx1) end.
    apply body_shape_binders; assumption.
Qed.

The case of a body unit under a weakening, with the induction hypotheses as premises.
Lemma wk_unit_body_case : forall Θ Ξ Γ Δu Δu' Φ Φ' Φx Φx' Δ φ,
    body_xp Θ Ξ (Δu ++ Γ) Φ Φx ->
    body_xp Θ Ξ (Δu' ++ Γ) Φ' Φx' ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ body_ctx Φx ++ Δu ≈ body_ctx Φx' ++ Δu' ->
    (forall Δ0 φ0, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢w φ0 : Γ ->
       Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢ˣ tele_wk (body_ctx Φx ++ Δu) φ0 ≈ tele_wk (body_ctx Φx' ++ Δu') φ0) ->
    (forall k Ψ H Ψ' H', List.nth_error (body_opens Φ Φx) k = Some (Ψ, H) -> List.nth_error (body_opens Φ' Φx') k = Some (Ψ', H') ->
       Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Ψ ++ Δu ++ Γ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H') ->
    (forall k Ψ H Ψ' H', List.nth_error (body_opens Φ Φx) k = Some (Ψ, H) -> List.nth_error (body_opens Φ' Φx') k = Some (Ψ', H') ->
       forall Δ0 φ0, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢w φ0 : Ψ ++ Δu ++ Γ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢ᵐ modexp_wk H φ0 ≈ modexp_wk H' φ0) ->
    (forall k Ψ H Ψ' H', List.nth_error (body_opens Φ Φx) k = Some (Ψ, H) -> List.nth_error (body_opens Φ' Φx') k = Some (Ψ', H') ->
       Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Ψ' ++ Δu' ++ Γ ⊢ᵐ H' ≈ H') ->
    (forall k Ψ H Ψ' H', List.nth_error (body_opens Φ Φx) k = Some (Ψ, H) -> List.nth_error (body_opens Φ' Φx') k = Some (Ψ', H') ->
       forall Δ0 φ0, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢w φ0 : Ψ' ++ Δu' ++ Γ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢ᵐ modexp_wk H' φ0 ≈ modexp_wk H' φ0) ->
    tele_ass Δu -> tele_ass Δu' -> length Δu = length Δu' ->
    body_shape Φ Φ' -> body_shape Φx Φx' -> List.NoDup (gm_names Φ) ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢w φ : Γ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ᵘ gunit_wk (gu_body Δu Φ) φ ≈ gunit_wk (gu_body Δu' Φ') φ.
Proof.
  intros * Hb Hb' Hx IHx Ho IHo Ho' IHo' Ha Ha' Hl Hs Hsx Hn Hφ.
  assert (Hc : gctx_closed Θ Ξ) by (eapply wf_gctx_closed; eapply ext_eq_ctx_left; exact (IHx _ _ Hφ)).
  pose proof (IHx _ _ Hφ) as Hxφ.
  rewrite !gunit_wk_mk; cbn [moddef_wk].
  eapply wf_unit_eq_body.
  - eapply body_xp_wk; [ exact Hc | exact Hb | apply wk_mod_compat_ext; eauto using wf_wk_mod_compat ].
  - eapply body_xp_wk; [ exact Hc | exact Hb' | apply wk_mod_compat_ext; eauto using wf_wk_mod_compat ].
  - rewrite !body_ctx_wk, <- !tele_wk_app; exact Hxφ.
  - intros k Ψw Hw Ψw' Hw' Hk Hk'.
    rewrite (body_opens_wk _ _ _ _ _ Hb), List.nth_error_map in Hk.
    rewrite (body_opens_wk _ _ _ _ _ Hb'), List.nth_error_map in Hk'.
    destruct (List.nth_error (body_opens Φ Φx) k) as [[Ψ H] |] eqn:Ek; [| discriminate ].
    destruct (List.nth_error (body_opens Φ' Φx') k) as [[Ψ' H'] |] eqn:Ek'; [| discriminate ].
    cbn in Hk, Hk'; injection Hk as <- <-; injection Hk' as <- <-.
    pose proof (body_opens_lengths _ _ _ _ _ Hb _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hb' Hs Ek Ek') as HlΨ.
    destruct (body_opens_prefix _ _ _ _ _ Hb _ _ _ Ek) as [Ψr HΨr].
    assert (HΔ : ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ tele_wk (Ψ ++ Δu) φ ++ Δ).
    { pose proof (ext_eq_ctx_left _ _ _ _ _ Hxφ) as HC; rewrite HΨr, <- List.app_assoc, tele_wk_app, <- List.app_assoc in HC.
      eapply wf_ctx_app_tail; exact HC. }
    pose proof (wf_wk_ext _ _ (Ψ ++ Δu) _ _ _ Hφ HΔ ltac:(rewrite <- List.app_assoc; exact (presup_modexp_eq_ctx (Ho _ _ _ _ _ Ek Ek')))) as Hφe.
    rewrite <- List.app_assoc in Hφe.
    pose proof (IHo _ _ _ _ _ Ek Ek' _ _ Hφe) as HH.
    rewrite tele_wk_app, <- List.app_assoc, List.length_app in HH.
    rewrite <- HlΨ, <- Hl, (modexp_wk_wk_eq H _ _ (wk_qn_add _ _ _)), (modexp_wk_wk_eq H' _ _ (wk_qn_add _ _ _)); exact HH.
  - intros k Ψw Hw Ψw' Hw' Hk Hk'.
    rewrite (body_opens_wk _ _ _ _ _ Hb), List.nth_error_map in Hk.
    rewrite (body_opens_wk _ _ _ _ _ Hb'), List.nth_error_map in Hk'.
    destruct (List.nth_error (body_opens Φ Φx) k) as [[Ψ H] |] eqn:Ek; [| discriminate ].
    destruct (List.nth_error (body_opens Φ' Φx') k) as [[Ψ' H'] |] eqn:Ek'; [| discriminate ].
    cbn in Hk, Hk'; injection Hk as <- <-; injection Hk' as <- <-.
    destruct (body_opens_prefix _ _ _ _ _ Hb' _ _ _ Ek') as [Ψr HΨr].
    assert (HΔ : ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ tele_wk (Ψ' ++ Δu') φ ++ Δ).
    { pose proof (ext_eq_ctx_right _ _ _ _ _ Hxφ) as HC; rewrite HΨr, <- List.app_assoc, tele_wk_app, <- List.app_assoc in HC.
      eapply wf_ctx_app_tail; exact HC. }
    pose proof (wf_wk_ext _ _ (Ψ' ++ Δu') _ _ _ Hφ HΔ ltac:(rewrite <- List.app_assoc; exact (presup_modexp_eq_ctx (Ho' _ _ _ _ _ Ek Ek')))) as Hφe.
    rewrite <- List.app_assoc in Hφe.
    pose proof (IHo' _ _ _ _ _ Ek Ek' _ _ Hφe) as HH.
    rewrite tele_wk_app, <- List.app_assoc, List.length_app in HH.
    rewrite (modexp_wk_wk_eq H' _ _ (wk_qn_add _ _ _)); exact HH.
  - apply tele_ass_wk; assumption.
  - apply tele_ass_wk; assumption.
  - rewrite !length_tele_wk; assumption.
  - apply body_shape_wk; assumption.
  - apply body_shape_wk; assumption.
  - rewrite gm_names_wk; assumption.
Qed.

Weakening Preserves the Judgments (wk_preserves_wf)


Lemma wk_preserves_wf :
  (forall Θ Ξ Γ A M,
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : A ->
      forall Δ φ, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢w φ : Γ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ M[φ]ʷ : A[φ]ʷ) /\
  (forall Θ Ξ Γ A M M',
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : A ->
      forall Δ φ, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢w φ : Γ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ M[φ]ʷ ≈ M'[φ]ʷ : A[φ]ʷ) /\
  (forall Θ Ξ Γ A A',
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A ⊆ A' ->
      forall Δ φ, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢w φ : Γ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ A[φ]ʷ ⊆ A'[φ]ʷ) /\
  (forall Θ Ξ Γ Ψ Ψ',
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ Ψ ≈ Ψ' ->
      forall Δ φ, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢w φ : Γ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ˣ tele_wk Ψ φ ≈ tele_wk Ψ' φ) /\
  (forall Θ Ξ Γ U U',
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ U ≈ U' ->
      forall Δ φ, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢w φ : Γ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ᵘ gunit_wk U φ ≈ gunit_wk U' φ) /\
  (forall Θ Ξ Γ H H',
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H' ->
      forall Δ φ, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢w φ : Γ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ᵐ modexp_wk H φ ≈ modexp_wk H' φ).
Proof.
  apply syntactic_wf_mut_ind'; intros; destruct_let_ann;
    try solve [ first [ eapply wk_elim_case | eapply wk_elim_cong_case | eapply wk_elim_iota_case ]; eassumption ];
    saturate_wk; push_wk; lift_wk.
The cases of globals: the recorded type is closed, so the operation on it disappears, and the rule applies at the type the induction hypothesis gives.
  all: try solve [ push_closed; mauto 3 ].
With the weakenings pushed in and the lifted ones in the context, most cases are the corresponding rule applied to the induction hypotheses.
  all: try solve [ mauto 4 ].
For the wider rules the rule application itself is what eauto does not reach in time, so we take that step by hand.
  all: try solve [ econstructor; mauto 3 ].
The module rules.
  all: try solve [ rewrite ?exp_wk_sub_extend_mod; eapply wf_let_mod; eauto 6 using wf_wk_q_mod, wf_unit_eq_refl_left ].
  all: try solve [ rewrite !exp_wk_sub_extend_mod; eapply wf_exp_eq_let_mod_zeta; eauto using wf_wk_q_mod ].
  all: try solve [ rewrite exp_wk_sub_extend_mod; eapply wf_exp_eq_let_mod_cong;
                   [ eauto | eauto 6 using wf_wk_q_mod, wf_unit_eq_refl_left | rewrite <- exp_wk_sub_extend_mod; eauto ] ].
  all: try solve [ first [ eapply wf_mem | eapply wf_exp_eq_mem_delta ];
                   [ apply me_noargs_wk; assumption | eauto
                   | eapply (member_type_wk_term _ _ ltac:(eauto using wf_gctx_closed)); eauto using wf_wk_mod_compat
                   | eauto
                   | unfold member_unfold in *; eapply member_unfold_wk; eauto using wf_gctx_closed, wf_wk_mod_compat
                   | eauto ] ].
  all: try solve [ rewrite ?apps_wk, ?member_ref_wk; first [ eapply wf_mem_app | eapply wf_exp_eq_mem_app ];
                   [ eauto | apply modexp_spine_wk; eassumption
                   | match goal with H : _ <> nil |- _ => destruct args; [ contradiction H; reflexivity | discriminate ] end
                   | eauto | rewrite <- member_ref_wk, <- apps_wk; eauto ] ].
  all: try solve [ cbn [tele_wk]; first [ eapply wf_ext_eq_ass | eapply wf_ext_eq_def | eapply wf_ext_eq_mod ];
                   eauto 7 using wf_wk_ext, ext_eq_ctx_left, ext_eq_ctx_right, presup_exp_ctx, presup_exp_eq_ctx, presup_unit_eq_ctx ].

  all: try solve [ eapply wf_me_mem;
                   [ eauto | eapply (member_type_wk_res _ _ ltac:(eauto using wf_gctx_closed)); eauto using wf_wk_mod_compat
                   | apply mres_tl_wk; eassumption
                   | eapply (member_type_wk_res _ _ ltac:(eauto using wf_gctx_closed)); eauto using wf_wk_mod_compat
                   | apply mres_tl_wk; eassumption ] ].
  all: try solve [ eapply wf_exp_eq_mem_cong; [ apply me_noargs_wk; assumption | apply me_noargs_wk; assumption | eauto
                   | eapply (member_type_wk_term _ _ ltac:(eauto using wf_gctx_closed)); eauto using wf_wk_mod_compat
                   | eauto.. ] ].
Extensions: the entry is moved by the weakening lifted over the extension before it.
  all: try solve [ cbn [tele_wk];
    match goal with

        let Hr := fresh "Hr" in

        [ exact (IHx _ _ Hφ) | .. ];

Units.

        eapply wf_unit_eq_alias; [ exact (IHx _ _ Hφ) | apply tele_ass_wk; assumption | apply tele_ass_wk; assumption | eauto | rewrite <- ?Hlen in *; eauto ]
    end ].
  all: try solve [ eapply wk_unit_body_case; eassumption ].
The remaining cases name their induction hypotheses by shape.
  all: try solve [ rewrite !gunit_wk_mk; cbn [moddef_wk];
    match goal with

      IHE : forall _ _, wf_wk _ _ _ (?D ++ ?Γ) _ -> wf_modexp_eq _ _ _ _ _,
      IHE' : forall _ _, wf_wk _ _ _ (?D' ++ ?Γ) _ -> wf_modexp_eq _ _ _ _ _,
      Hφ : wf_wk _ _ _ ?Γ _ |- wf_unit_eq _ _ _ (gu_mk (tele_wk ?D _) _) _ =>

        let Hr := fresh "Hr" in

        pose proof (ext_eq_length _ _ _ _ _ Hx) as Hlen;
        eapply wf_unit_eq_alias;
        [ exact (IHx _ _ Hφ) | apply tele_ass_wk; assumption | apply tele_ass_wk; assumption
        | rewrite <- Hlen; exact (IHE _ _ Hl) | exact (IHE' _ _ Hr) ]
    end ].
  all: try solve [
    match goal with
    | Hp : mod_qname ?H = Some _, Hm : member_type _ _ ?Γ ?H nil ?R, Htl : mres_tl ?R = Some _, Hφ : wf_wk _ _ _ ?Γ ?φ |- _ =>
        assert (Hc : gctx_closed Θ Ξ) by (eapply wf_gctx_closed; eauto with mctt);
        pose proof (member_type_wk_res _ _ Hc _ _ _ _ Hm _ _ (wf_wk_mod_compat _ _ _ _ _ Hφ)) as Hm';

  all: try solve [

      Hv : tele_view ?T = Some _, Hv' : tele_view ?T' = Some _,
      Hφ : wf_wk _ _ _ ?Γ _ |- wf_modexp_eq _ _ _ (me_app (modexp_wk ?H _) _) (me_app (modexp_wk ?H' _) _) =>
        assert (Hc : gctx_closed Θ Ξ) by (eapply wf_gctx_closed; eauto with mctt);
        eapply wf_me_app;
        [ eauto
        | exact (member_type_wk_res _ _ Hc _ _ _ _ Hm _ _ (wf_wk_mod_compat _ _ _ _ _ Hφ))
        | apply mres_tl_wk; exact Htl
        | exact (tele_view_wk_some _ _ _ _ Hv) | eauto | eauto | eauto
        | exact (member_type_wk_res _ _ Hc _ _ _ _ Hm' _ _ (wf_wk_mod_compat _ _ _ _ _ Hφ))
        | apply mres_tl_wk; exact Htl'
        | exact (tele_view_wk_some _ _ _ _ Hv') | eauto | eauto ]
    end ].
  all: try solve [
    match goal with
    | HU : wf_unit_eq _ _ ?Γ ?U ?U', IHU : forall _ _, wf_wk _ _ _ ?Γ _ -> wf_unit_eq _ _ _ _ _,
      IHB : forall _ _, wf_wk _ _ _ (ce_mod ?U :: ?Γ) _ -> _,
      IHL : forall _ _, wf_wk _ _ _ ?Γ _ -> _,
      Hφ : wf_wk _ _ _ ?Γ _ |- _ =>
        pose proof (IHU _ _ Hφ) as HUφ;
        pose proof (IHL _ _ Hφ) as HL; rewrite exp_wk_sub_extend_mod in HL |- *;
        eapply wf_exp_eq_let_mod_cong;
        [ exact HUφ
        | apply IHB; apply wf_wk_q_mod; eauto using wf_unit_eq_refl_left
        | exact HL ]
    end ].
The small Π: the domain is moved into a large universe by its level, and the codomain's universe, the weakened level, commutes with the lifted weakening.
  all: try solve [
    match goal with
    | HL : forall Δ0 φ0, wf_wk ?T ?X Δ0 ?Γ φ0 -> wf_exp ?T ?X Δ0 (a_level ?n) ?L[φ0]ʷ,
      HA : wf_exp ?T ?X ?Γ (a_univ ?L) ?A,
